verdict.rationale: FireHydrant ships fhcli, a command-line tool explicitly documented for submitting events from CI/orchestration systems (Jenkins builds, Docker image creation, deploy events), plus a full REST API with token-based API keys and webhooks that let you drive incidents, runbooks, and alerts headlessly without the UI. This directly satisfies running the product in automated/CI pipelines. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of fhcli in real CI pipelines and more detail on CLI command coverage beyond deploy/event tracking.
